parameters.name: AccessMode
parameters.description:
The access mode for website services. Valid values:
- **0**: A record
- **1**: Anti-DDoS Pro mode
- **2**: Back-to-origin mode

parameters.name: Domain
parameters.description:
The domain name of the website service.
> The domain name must have forwarding rules configured. You can call [DescribeDomains](~~91724~~) to query all domain names.
